719-6991-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-6991-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2099-2131-4574-6900--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
2099-2131-4574-6900--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

69-116-539-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
69-116-539-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-116-539-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

883-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

486-1978-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Halflings.
486-1978-7908.description:
Cause The Notary Hobbits to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The Notary Hobbits.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-4772-5285.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

206-2034-3755-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2897-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2897-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Gigantoplasm and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2897-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1409-3099-4289-4785.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1322-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1322-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1322-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

967-4166-5078-7746.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the HYDRA Assault Robot trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

4377-6927-7631.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Damage Control Crew
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2577-5147-7390.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.

1558-2638-3129-4231-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.

Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2933-4013-5798-7297.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve both Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Badgermole

When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

454-1978-4188.description:

Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Goblin Medics by tapping it, adding {U}.

Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Goblin Medics.
Repeat.

You have seven or more cards in your graveyard.

1462-3277-6801.description:
Activate any number of permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Cast Cleansing Meditation by paying {1}{W}{W}, destroying all permanents as they are all enchantments due to Enchanted Evening, and then returning all cards in your graveyard destroyed this way to the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cleansing Meditation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1462-3277-6801.notes: You can repeat this combo as desired during your turns to continually wipe out opponents' permanents.

Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.

Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
4785-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token, adding {R}.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2178-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.

Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.

1355-3457-4235.description:

Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Sanctum Weaver.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat.

Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego sacrificing Mechtitan Core tokens to Ashnod's Altar, and then target any other applicable permanents using Astral Dragon.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tribal Forcemage, adding {1}.

Activate Tribal Forcemage's morph ability by paying {1}{G}, turning it face up.
Tribal Forcemage triggers, giving creatures of a chosen creature type +2/+2 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

Lu Su does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
1339-1636-4855.description:

The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

Cast Out of Time by paying {1}{W}{W}.

Holding priority, activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Out of Time from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Out of Time trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

784-2829-3363.description:

Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn.
Silas Renn triggers, allowing you to cast The One Ring from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The One Ring from your graveyard by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.

2645-3443.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

Dread Slaver dies, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Displacer Kitten and Haze of Rage's storm ability triggers.

Resolve each Haze of Rage copy, causing creatures you control to get +1/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the original Haze of Rage, causing creatures you control to get +1/+0 until end of turn and returning Haze of Rage to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}.

Use Lotus Cobra to gain {G} and Embodiment of Insight to make Drownyard Temple a creature.
Sacrifice Drownyard Temple to Ashnod's Altar.
Repeat.

1992-4419-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.

Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Renata trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
